evidence: M-O s.v. garbage can, after Egger
terms.comment: Lewis & Short has only the plural excipula, receptacles.

receptāculum, a place that receives things (Livy calls the Cloaca Maxima receptāculum omnium pūrgāmentōrum urbis, 1.56.2), with quisquiliae, sweepings, rubbish (both from Lewis & Short). Andresian’s picture is a large outdoor bin.

sources: Lewis & Short: excipula

Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. clean house, clean up, tidy up, broom: dustpan, garbage, trash, garbage can, waste basket. John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 38, 39, 290, 292, 307, 320, 401, 404.
